sentences.en: The rail-line was carried under the Tsugaru Strait to Hokkaido.
sentences.zh: 铁路线穿过津轻海峡到达北海道。

sentences.en: At this point the sea narrows into a strait.
sentences.zh: 此时海洋变窄成为一条海峡。

sentences.en: Have you ever gone through the Straits of Magellan?
sentences.zh: 你曾穿越过麦哲伦海峡吗？

senses.zh: 困难的，窘迫的；狭窄的；严格的
